One paragraph above two or three bullets is enough for most specs, and around 150 words is plenty. Where an earlier issue already explains something, write its #N rather than explaining it a second time.

Pick at least one label in the sidebar, because GitHub files each pull request under a release-notes category by the labels copied onto it from its issue. A maintainer sets the label where you lack triage access. -->
